production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT youthful adult male elf Mike: blue eyes, long blond hair tied behind, pointed ears, blue robe with detailed gold trim, BLACK gloves, black boots, red-brown gold spellbook, sheathed dagger. Do not feminize, change face or use chibi proportions. His book is deliberately secured in its belt pouch whenever BOTH hands work; otherwise keep it in his anatomical LEFT arm. Gloves stay black in every pose. Eight chronological STORY POSES, left to right top then bottom. 1 reads a parchment in both hands; 2 compares parchment and unseen emblem to the right; 3 realization with parchment; 4 points to right with parchment retained; 5 gives thumbs-up toward camera with parchment; 6 puzzled with parchment; 7 scratches head, parchment in other hand; 8 sad but calm, still holds parchment. Feet stay at exactly the same baseline. This is a pose library, not eight phases falsely called a walk. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
